page_title: MAR 3-1 LEN | Marseille v Lens 24/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+2' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
87' Anthony Bermont (Lens) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Geronimo Rulli easily deals with the threat.
85' 3 - 1 Rayan Fofana (Lens) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the middle of the goal.
84' Handball by Florian Sotoca (Lens). Marseille are awarded the free kick.
83' Saud Abdulhamid (Lens) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
81' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
80' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Amine Gouiri.
78' Pierre Sage prepares a substitution. Florian Thauvin is replaced by Florian Sotoca (Lens).
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Anthony Bermont (Lens) comes onto the pitch so that Ruben Aguilar can be given a rest.
77' Referee Benoit Bastien points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Amine Gouiri (Marseille) goes wild in celebration.
76' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Marseille players aren’t happy.
75' 3 - 0 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Amine Gouiri (Marseille) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom left corner. Good team effort!
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matt O'Riley (Marseille) replaces Quinten Timber.
74' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Darryl Bakola (Marseille) replaces Hamed Junior Traore.
74' Substitution. Nayef Aguerd will be replaced by Benjamin Pavard (Marseille).
73' Abdallah Sima (Lens) is flagged for offside.
73' Hamed Junior Traore (Marseille) sends a long ball in, but Robin Risser comfortably gathers the ball.
72' Here is a change. Adrien Thomasson is going off and Pierre Sage gives the last tactical orders to Andrija Bulatovic (Lens).
72' That will be all from Wesley Said who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Rayan Fofana (Lens).
70' Benoit Bastien shows a yellow card to Florian Thauvin (Lens) for a tough tackle.
70' Booking. Quinten Timber (Marseille) receives a caution from the referee.
70' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) leaps like a salmon and plants a great close-range header from the corner towards goal, but the effort is blocked at the last moment.
70' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

69' That's unlucky! Amine Gouiri (Marseille) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
69' The resulting corner from Amine Gouiri (Marseille) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
68' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. Now Marseille have a corner.
67' Marseille are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
64' The corner from Florian Thauvin (Lens) is intercepted by Geronimo Rulli.
64' Abdallah Sima (Lens) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lens will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
61' A yellow card for a tackle by Mamadou Sangare (Lens). Benoit Bastien doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
60' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but sends his shot slightly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Marseille will have a goal kick.
59' Pierre Sage has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Abdallah Sima (Lens) replacing Odsonne Edouard.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ethan Nwaneri leaves the pitch and Mason Greenwood (Marseille) comes on.
58' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) plays a terrific long ball forward to Adrien Thomasson, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.

56' Ethan Nwaneri (Marseille) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Hamed Junior Traore was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
54' Ethan Nwaneri (Marseille) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the roof of the net. Robin Risser is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
53' Wesley Said (Lens) sends a long ball in, but Geronimo Rulli comfortably gathers the ball.

51' The game is interrupted. Florian Thauvin (Lens) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. A free kick has been awarded to Marseille.
50' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle after Ruben Aguilar (Lens) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Marseille have a free kick.
49' Florian Thauvin (Lens) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Marseille will take a free kick.
48' Florian Thauvin (Lens) sends a long ball in, but Geronimo Rulli comfortably gathers the ball.
47' Hamed Junior Traore (Marseille) sends a long ball in, but Robin Risser comfortably gathers the ball.

46' Big chance! A simple pass from Ruben Aguilar left Adrien Thomasson (Lens) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) sends a long ball in, but Robin Risser comfortably gathers the ball.
43' Ethan Nwaneri (Marseille) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
40' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille). Benoit Bastien saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
37' Wesley Said (Lens) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
36' Great teamplay by Marseille as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
33' Wesley Said (Lens) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Adrien Thomasson, but Geronimo Rulli displays great awareness to stop him.
31' Wesley Said (Lens) sends a long ball in, but Geronimo Rulli comfortably gathers the ball.
31' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

28' CHANCE! Odsonne Edouard (Lens) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
27' Saud Abdulhamid (Lens) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
25' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
24' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle and signals a foul after Matthieu Udol (Lens) brought his opponent down. It's a free kick to Marseille, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
22' Florian Thauvin (Lens) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick to Marseille.
18' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Benoit Bastien saw the whole situation. A free kick is awarded to Lens.
16' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle after Wesley Said (Lens) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. It's a free kick to Marseille in a dangerous position.
15' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

13' 2 - 0 Goal! Ethan Nwaneri (Marseille) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Robin Risser had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:0.

12' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but is easily stopped by a save from Robin Risser and the score remains the same.
11' Benoit Bastien couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ruben Aguilar (Lens) and blew his whistle. Marseille are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
10' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Lens win a free kick.
8' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
7' A clumsy foul by Quinten Timber (Marseille) and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle. Lens are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
6' Marseille control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
3' 1 - 0 Goal! Amine Gouiri (Marseille) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Robin Risser. He makes it 1:0.
2' Quinten Timber (Marseille) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Marseille will kick the game off.
Benoit Bastien is introduced as the referee for today's match.
